profile_text.body:
EPAM Systems is a software engineering and product development services company that describes itself as helping customers digitally transform their businesses through software engineering, design, and consulting services. It says it has operated since 1993 and that its teams of technologists, strategists, and designers deliver digital experiences. The company states that it specializes in 11 industries across 55+ countries and regions. Its site lists addresses in Bengaluru, Karnataka and Gurugram, Haryana, India.

EPAM Systems is a public company traded under the ticker EPAM. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0001352010.

The available material does not include any tracked products, lawsuits, or MCP servers for the company.
